import os
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs/task-1671227a.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The left half is a sequence of framed masks; the right half contains
    # colored silhouettes. Match silhouettes allowing quarter-turn rotations.
    sep = next((c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == 0 for row in grid)), w)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, left[0][0])})

    def norm(points):
        a=min(r for r,c in points); b=min(c for r,c in points)
        return frozenset((r-a,c-b) for r,c in points)
    def variants(points):
        out=set()
        for k in range(4):
            q=list(points)
            for _ in range(k):
                q=[(c,-r) for r,c in q]
            out.add(norm(q))
        return out

    shapes={}
    for color in colors:
        pts=[(r,c-sep) for r in range(h) for c in range(sep,w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        if pts: shapes[color]=variants(pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in left]
    r=0
    while r<h:
        if all(v==left[r][0] for v in left[r]):
            r+=1; continue
        # A framed block extends between rows filled with its border color.
        border=left[r][0]; end=r+1
        while end<h and not all(v==border for v in left[end]): end+=1
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(r,end) for j in range(len(left[0])) if left[i][j]==0]
        if pts:
            mask=variants(pts)
            color=next((c for c,vs in shapes.items() if mask & vs), None)
            if color is not None:
                for i,j in pts: out[i][j]=color
        r=end
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
print(p, len(code))
